CustomField.description: How the records in a duplicate group are compared on the field: HasValue, IsBlank, IsTrue, IsFalse, Oldest, Newest, Largest, Smallest, Longest, Shortest, Equals, NotEquals or Contains. Rules are applied in Order; each one narrows the group to the records it prefers until a single record is left.
